title: The cut-open torus's spectrum is four copies of a cone's, and at powers of two one return map's
subject: Networks of rings joined by shared contacts, read with the canonical knot test on their space-time law
conclusion: The cut-open torus's spectrum is four copies of its quarter-turn cone's, and at powers of two the cone's is one return map of the cut line, whose Smith form is the cone's Jordan data. Computed to side 64 (and the collapse at 128), every eigenvalue is a (2n - 1)-th root of unity of multiplicity k(k + 1)/2 with Jordan blocks 2k - 1, 2k - 5, ...; why at every power of two stays open.
